outcome.label: Primary completion rate
outcome.coverage_note: Every World Bank education outcome series stops in 2010-2011 (C-07), so it cannot see the APC tenures at all; NEMIS is unreachable (C-12). Declared gap.

design.name: National VECM / ARDL time series
design.estimand: long-run multiplier for the administration effect, oil-interacted
design.estimator: VECM (vars + urca Johansen), ARDL (dynlm) fallback per the cointegration test
design_controls: Linear and quadratic time trend absorb secular drift
Oil price is interacted with administration, never partialled out (base spec section 9)

nodes.label: Brent crude price (logged)
nodes.source: FRED DCOILBRENTEU (Brent crude, daily) via ingestion/flows/pull_fred.py

nodes.label: Lagged outcome
nodes.source: Derived: lagged value of the outcome

nodes.label: Linear and quadratic time trend
nodes.source: Design construct: linear and quadratic trend

nodes.label: Omitted time-varying determinant
nodes.source: Unobserved: assumed absent by the conditional-exogeneity assumption

nodes.label: FAAC allocation / fiscal space
nodes.source: NBS FAAC disbursement reports via ingestion/flows/pull_faac.py — 114 national months, 2016-12 to 2026-06

nodes.label: NGN/USD exchange rate
nodes.source: World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF (annual); CBN needed for monthly

identifying_assumption: Conditional exogeneity: given the oil price, the lagged outcome, fiscal and FX controls and the trend, the administration dummy is unrelated to any remaining time-varying determinant of the outcome (the unobserved node is absent).
cannot_rule_out: FAAC and the exchange rate are downstream of the administration, so conditioning on them identifies a *direct* effect net of the fiscal and FX channel, not the total effect.
Only ~26 annual observations and five administrations — the interval is wide by construction.
Structural breaks (2014 rebasing, 2016 and 2023 regime changes) are not fully absorbed by trends.
Oil is treated as exogenous to Nigerian policy, which the 2016 and 2020 episodes roughly support but do not prove.

checks.detail: only 8 native observations in the window (minimum 12) — not tested
8 annual observations — too few to fit the Tier-3 design

the base-spec Tier-3 system includes FAAC, which has no metric-catalogue entry (the monthly state panel landed 2026-10-16 and is Stage 3 gated, but it has no declared monthly-to-annual aggregation and no outcome decision); the system is reduced to {Y, log(oil), fx}
